body.current_gate: human-verifiable abstract cyclic Green-homotopy transfer theorem
body.forbid: no theorem inferred only from examples; no isolated-operator Green inverse assumption; no support claim for a non-support-local shear; no arbitrary-background or nonlinear promotion
body.resource_hint: PROOF-FIRST BRIDGE LANE. Reuse certified cylinder/Berger/Nariai consumers as examples, but the abstract proof and hypotheses are the deliverable.
